page.content:
King of Ithaca whose nostos is the Odyssey.

How Odysseus connects

  • Work: Odyssey — The Odyssey is the epic of Odysseus' return from Troy.
  • Event: Trojan War — Odysseus fights at Troy and devises the wooden horse.
  • Character: Poseidon — Poseidon delays Odysseus' return after the Cyclops is blinded.
  • Character: Athena — Athena is Odysseus' divine counselor through the war and the return.
  • Location: Underworld — Odysseus consults the dead in the Nekyia of the Odyssey.

What is Odysseus?

Odysseus is the cunning hero of the Trojan Horse and the ten-year return. Athena favors him; Poseidon delays him; Penelope and the suitors wait in Ithaca.

Key threads lead to Odyssey, Trojan War, Poseidon, Athena and Underworld.
